dedupe_keys.name: fhn azerbaijan emergency statistics quarterly half yearly and annual reports on natural and technogenic incidents fires casualties rescues and evacuations 2020 to 2026

description: These reports are the official statistics of Azerbaijan's Ministry of Emergency Situations (FHN) on the incidents its services respond to. Quarterly, half-yearly and annual PDF reports are published for 2020 to 2026. They count natural and technogenic emergencies, deaths, injuries, people rescued and evacuated, and fire call-outs, each compared with the same period of the previous year; the 2025 annual report, for example, records 19,881 incidents, 78 deaths, 277 injuries, 70 people rescued, 877 evacuated and 19,545 fire call-outs. The reports are free and available to download as PDF from the statistics page in English and Azerbaijani; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: the tables are national aggregates in PDF, with little breakdown by district, so values must be transcribed, and definitions of incident types are not documented on the page. Simulation uses: calibrating the annual demand on fire and rescue services, setting base rates of emergencies for scenario studies, and tracking trends in casualties for resilience indicators. Related records: the CTIF world fire statistics (data-ctif-world-fire-statistics) compile national fire counts across countries, and the Nordic fire statistics (data-nordic-fire-statistics) are a regional comparison.
